name: Facet
text: We should implement a system-wide dark theme by default, as it provides better visibility and clarity, especially for data visualization. This decision is based on the Manus Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard, which both utilize dark themes to enhance user experience. By doing so, we are accepting the trade-off that some users may need to adjust to a new visual style, but this is outweighed by the benefits of improved readability and reduced eye strain. Overall, a dark theme will contribute to a more enjoyable and lively interface, aligning with our goal of creating an engaging visualization experience.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The real risk isn’t just extra design work—it’s that the light mode toggle becomes a permanent crutch, locking users into a half-baked solution. A better alternative: default to dark mode but let users opt out permanently after 30 days of use, then measure retention. Settle it with a live A/B test showing task completion time and user satisfaction scores.
